title: MundiSense v1: Audio-visual emotion perception
desc: Recognizing observable emotional expression in Chinese speech and facial video. A Qwen2.5-Omni multimodal LLM adapted with LoRA works with HuBERT audio and CLIP visual specialists, followed by frozen fusion, calibration and abstention rules.
note: EmotionTalk R3: macro-F1 0.645 on 1,929 utterances, without threshold rejection. Research system; expression estimates do not establish a person’s inner state.

title: Practical guidelines for cell segmentation models under optical aberrations in microscopy
authors: Boyuan Peng†, Jiaju Chen†, P. Bilha Githinji†, Ijaz Gul, et al.
desc: A robustness benchmark for cell instance segmentation under simulated optical aberrations in fluorescence and bright-field microscopy. The study compares segmentation architectures and Cellpose 2.0, and introduces PLCM to identify aberration properties from point spread functions.
note: DynamicNuclearNet + LIVECell · Optical priors · Model-selection guidelines
figure_alt: Illustration of microscopy, optical aberrations, PSF guidance and cell instance segmentation.

title: PSF-guided conditional diffusion for microscopy aberration correction
desc: Exploring point spread functions as physical conditioning for diffusion-based restoration of aberrated microscopy images. The goal is to recover cellular structure and boundaries while incorporating knowledge of the optical imaging process.
note: Physical embedding · Conditional diffusion · Microscopy restoration
figure_alt: Illustration of PSF-conditioned diffusion for restoration of aberrated microscopy images.

title: Dual-Modality Computational Ophthalmic Imaging with Deep Learning and Coaxial Optical Design
authors: Boyuan Peng†, Jiaju Chen†, Yiwei Zhang†, Cuiyi Peng, et al.
desc: A coaxial optical platform combines fundus imaging and refractive sensing. Learning-based pupil localization supports alignment, while retinal vessel segmentation and multimodal learning connect optical measurements with ophthalmic screening research.
note: Coaxial optics · Automated alignment · Retinal vessel analysis
figure_alt: Illustration of coaxial ophthalmic optics, fundus and refractive imaging, alignment and image fusion.

title: Convolutional neural networks for rapid diagnosis and lesion detection of pediatric mycoplasma pneumoniae pneumonia using chest X-rays
authors: Jiaming Deng†, Danqing Yu†, Boyuan Peng†, Dongmei Yu†, et al.
desc: ConvNeXt-Tiny distinguishes mycoplasma, bacterial and viral pneumonia from normal pediatric chest X-rays. Score-CAM highlights regions associated with model predictions, with an Android application prototype for exploring results.
note: Reported test accuracy: 88.20% · AUROC: 0.9218 · Four-class research evaluation
figure_alt: Illustration of chest X-ray classification with ConvNeXt-Tiny and Score-CAM attribution.

title: Intelligent proximate analysis of coal based on near-infrared spectroscopy
authors: Weinan Liu, Boyuan Peng, Xiaoyu Liu, et al.
desc: Near-infrared spectra provide a rapid, nondestructive route to estimating moisture, volatile matter and calorific value. The study compares random forests, extreme learning machines and particle-swarm-optimized ELM regression.
figure_alt: Illustration of near-infrared coal spectroscopy and PSO–ELM prediction of material properties.
